name: Ward L. Lambert Fieldhouse and Gymnasium
changes_since_round2: Added a minimal Stadium Avenue sidewalk strip, curb, and staggered red-brown brick inlay immediately outside the existing entrance threshold. Purdue's ground-control notes identify the sidewalk and brick inlay at the main entrance; dimensions and paving extent are schematic.
Adjusted the block-glass glazing mix to make the existing glazed openings read as translucent glass block instead of dark voids. Existing window openings and facade placement were not moved.
Improved the exterior preview with a separate neutral camera-side softbox; interior preview lights remain disabled for exterior views to prevent light leakage through the schematic canopy.
The track mesh remains unchanged; lane-one centerline perimeter remeasured directly from its saved paired inner/outer vertices at 199.9889567 m.
